target: Paisaje de navegación de la Cuenca del Polvo Quieto en la Senda del Viento Bajo.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Depresión amplia de transición Korven–Edran donde el viento pierde fuerza y el horizonte empieza a abrirse.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of the canonical Cuenca del Polvo Quieto. Viewer descends from broken Korven stone into a broad shallow basin where wind-blown dust settles and the terrain begins opening toward Edran. Rock walls are lower and farther apart, scrub becomes more frequent, and a practical route crosses the quiet depression toward a widening horizon. Dust lies in sheltered patches rather than forming a storm. Neutral subdued daylight, gray-brown rock, dry muted grasses, strong sense of transition and navigable space.
negative_constraints: No buildings, ruins, monuments or vehicles
No creatures or characters as focal subject
No magical haze, glow, lava or crystals
